name: Brave Search
tagline: Independent web search API for privacy-focused results, news, images, videos, and AI answers.
description: Brave Search API provides independent web search results, news, images, videos, and AI-powered answers without relying on Google or Bing indexes. Developers use it for search-powered applications, RAG pipelines, research tools, and content discovery with privacy-first defaults. The API is served from api.search.brave.com with API-key authentication and documented free and paid usage tiers.

auth.details: API key via X-Subscription-Token header; self-serve signup at Brave Search API dashboard.

use_cases: run independent web search for a query
fetch recent news articles for a topic
search images or videos for a term
power RAG retrieval with live web results
build a privacy-focused search feature in an app
